name: remote-raspberry-pi-web-control-center
description: A web control center to deploy, run, monitor and control scripts on your Raspberry Pis

scripts.dev: bun run env:check && bun run dev:db && bun run env:sync && bun run db:migrate && turbo run dev --parallel
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/supabase && npx supabase migration up --local
scripts.db:reset: cd apps/supabase && npx supabase db reset
